g.text: Pi-Gen imaging: runtime topology after convergence (DeskPi Super6C, 6 x CM4 Lite)
Slurm partition default (5 workers, identical image and services)
10.42.0.0/24, no gateway, no DNS server (mDNS only)
each worker runs: slurmd :6818, munge, avahi-daemon,
optional k3s-agent (NODE_K3S=yes): baked config points at
dalmasca.local:6443, Ansible k3s_agent rewrites it to https:
(also written into group_vars/all.yml) and is not
overridden in config.head.yaml. That range contains
the node LAN 10.42.0.0/24, so opting into k3s puts
pod routes on top of host addresses. Set cluster-cidr
FINDING (likely, verify with "scontrol show partition"): slurm.conf
declares PartitionName=default. Slurm treats the name DEFAULT
case-insensitively as the defaults record, not a real partition,
so sinfo / srun may report no partition. Rename it (e.g. "compute").
mounted on every worker as SPHINX_ROOT.
